claim: The tweezers software keeps the laser control panel visible, shows whether the laser is on and at what power, gives quick access to an emergency shutdown, and shows the connection and state of every interlock. The laser can be switched on there only if every safety component is connected and every interlock is enabled; its status reads Standby when enabled but off, and Locking or Locked once on.
